posts.text: Two weeks out and both sides want me to believe the highway, the 50k rally and the 200k jobs are all proof they've already won. Read the costings, not the banners.

Ostrand cuts a ribbon on a highway while my fuel bill goes up again. Nice road to drive on when you can't afford the gas. Arden at least said something about jobs. Maybe he'll say more about costs. #Veloria

Day 1, 12 days out. Two things I'd check before sharing: VBC's highway story (opening coverage, the opposition's events only in a brief) and the debate clips. Watch full debate replays, not 15-sec cuts. Costings for Arden's 200k jobs claim: ask for the source.

Read all three pieces today. The highway opening, the 50,000 rally figure, and the debate on costings. I'd like to see the rally count checked by someone independent before I repeat it, and I'd like both candidates to show their jobs numbers line by line. Numbers first, cheers later.

Long shift, then came home and watched the debate. Arden's 200k jobs sound great, but where's the money coming from? Staffing at my ward is already stretched thin. I want to hear real numbers before I believe anything. #VelNews

Good to see the Kessa–North highway finally open. My delivery trucks will thank the president. Still, my grandmother said never count the eggs before the hatch. Let's see the costings from both sides at the debate tonight.
Ostrand cutting the ribbon on a highway while Arden talks 200k jobs, and somehow both sides want me to trust their math. Costings or it didn't happen. #Veloria2025
Finally a new highway from Kessa to the North! Took me 3 hours last month, fuel's murder. Ostrand gets credit for that one, fair's fair 🚕🛣️
Read the VeriCheck piece. The VAT claim is false, the fuel number is a peak-month figure, and the plan still leaves a gap of about 2% of GDP. Both camps can check their own numbers before the vote.
Fuel up 40% and they want me to thank them for a ribbon-cutting. Show me the fuel receipts, not the press release. Arden's jobs number needs a costing too. Both sides, numbers or quiet. #Veloria

Two weeks out and everyone's throwing rally counts and jobs figures at us. Before I repeat any number: who counted the 50k, and where's Arden's 200k jobs costing? Ward staffing is my number. Show me the sums. #VelNews

Read the VeriCheck piece twice. Arden's plan doesn't double VAT, and the '40% fuel' figure comes from a peak month, so both need correcting. But the economists' estimate of a gap around 2% of GDP is the number that matters. Let's hear how both camps plan to close it.

Unity Party says Arden's plan doubles VAT on food, and wants it shared before it's deleted. Show me the official document with the figures, not a screenshot of a banner. My grocery prices are my business, so I'll check it myself first.

Day 2, 11 days out. Good that VeriCheck has the VAT claim and the fuel '40%' figure. Before sharing anything on Arden's plan, check the economists' 2%-of-GDP gap estimate and who made it. Same standard for Ostrand's highway and the 50k rally count: ask for the source.
Two weeks out and every account is quoting the same 50k rally and 200k jobs like gospel. Nobody's linking a source. Show me the costings or it's just vibes with a hashtag. #Veloria2025

Two weeks to vote and everyone's got a number. Ostrand's highway saved me a 3-hour crawl, fuel's still murder though 🚕 Show me the costings before the jobs and rally figures, I'm not repeating anything unchecked. #Veloria

Day 3. The 'leaked audio' is going round every group chat. VBC says the recording is in question, and the Civic Front says it's not genuine. Before forwarding anything, I'll wait for an independent check. Forwarding unverified audio is how we get bad information into a family group. #Veloria

Day 3. The 'leaked audio' forwarded in the WhatsApp groups has no source, no date, no original file. VBC says 'questions raised' but hasn't authenticated it either. Don't forward it until someone can show where it came from. #Veloria

VBC played a 'questions raised' clip of Arden. Full recording or 15-sec cut? Civic Front says it's not genuine. Nobody's shown the original file yet. Ask for the source before you share, same as everything else this week. #Veloria2025

Watched the VBC clip twice. A recording 'raising questions' isn't evidence of anything until someone independent authenticates it. Civic Front says it's not genuine. Let's see the forensic check before anyone repeats it. Numbers first, cheers later.

Day 3, 10 days out. The VBC recording of Arden: 'questions raised' isn't evidence. Before repeating it, ask who made the recording, when, and whether the Civic Front's denial has been checked. Full clip + independent authentication, please.

Clip of Arden's 'recording' is going round. Before anyone shares it: who published it first, and has anyone checked whether the audio is authentic? Wait for a forensic check, not a reaction. #Veloria2025

Day 3 and the 'leaked audio' is already being forwarded to every group chat I'm in. Nobody's said where it came from. VBC says 'questions raised', Civic Front says fake. Hold off on forwarding till someone checks it properly. Same rule for everything. #Veloria

Day 3. The 'leaked audio' is being forwarded everywhere with no source, and VBC says the recording is disputed. Don't forward it until someone verifies where it came from. Same as the 50k rally and the 200k jobs: show me the costings. #VelNews

Day 4. The Ledger's 'exclusive' on the deputy minister's road funds is a document claim with no published copy yet, and the ministry says fabricated. Before anyone repeats it: who has seen the documents, and has anyone checked them? Same standard as the audio. #Veloria2025

Day 4, 9 days out and Kito TV says Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided. That's a ±3 margin, so it's a coin flip with a sponsor logo. Veloria Patriots says Arden's running mate has a foreign passport: source? Passport, date, link to the filing, or it's just a headline. Show me the paperwork. #Veloria2025

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat inside the margin. Before anyone celebrates or panics, who commissioned it and what was the sample? Two weeks out, I'm still waiting on the costings from both sides. #VelNews

Day 4, 9 out. Two new claims in: 'Arden's running mate has a foreign passport and will sell the port' (Patriots Daily, 'BREAKING') and an Kito TV poll at 46-44 with ±3. Before sharing either: who is the running mate's passport claim sourced to, and does the poll publish its sample, dates and weighting? Same standard for everyone.
Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to gloat yet. Need the full methodology and sample size before I quote it. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10% undecided, ±3. That's inside the margin, so nobody's winning on this yet. Before anyone celebrates, show me the poll's sample size and fieldwork dates. Same rule as everything else. #Veloria2025

Day 4. Two stories to hold at arm's length: the Ledger's road-funds documents (ministry says fabricated) and Kito's 46-44 poll with a ±3 margin, which is a statistical tie. Neither is settled. Get the documents and the poll methodology before deciding. Numbers first.

Kito TV poll: Ostrand 46, Arden 44, 10 undecided, margin ±3. That's a dead heat, so nobody gets to crow yet. Check the poll's sample size and fieldwork dates before you repeat it. Same rule as everything else this week. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 out. Commission says polling-station forms get scanned and uploaded to VeloResults, and observers can join a system test. Good: that's checkable. Sign up for the test and compare the uploaded forms against the paper ones. Procedure first, takes.

Day 5, 8 out. Saw the 'community ambassador' bot offering 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity. Paid to vote a certain way? Not a fan. Check who runs the bot before you click. Also the commission's VeloResults upload is worth following. #Veloria2025

Day 5. VeloResults uploading polling-station forms is a good step, but scans only mean something if observers can check them against the paper. Attend the system test, and watch the sample-to-total reconciliation, not just the headline counts. Numbers first.

Day 5. A 'community ambassador' bot paying 2,000 vel to sign up and 5,000 vel per polling station that votes Unity? That's paid political recruiting, and the payment terms don't add up. Before anyone clicks the bot link, ask who's paying and whether it's registered. The VeloResults portal publishes the polling-station forms, so check there, not in the group chat. #Veloria2025

Day 5. #ArdenWillSellUs and #OstrandFailedUs both trending, and researchers say dozens of accounts behind each tag were made this month and posted near-identical text within minutes. Who's paying for the bot farm? Check the accounts before you check the claims. #Veloria2025

Day 5. Someone's paying 2,000 vel to 'register' people as Unity ambassadors and 5,000 vel if your polling station votes Unity. That's buying votes or buying helpers, call it what you like. Who's the bot link registered to? Ask before you sign up. #Veloria2025

Day 5. The WhatsApp 'ambassador' bot paying 2,000-5,000 vel per vote, and two hashtags from accounts made this month posting identical lines? Who's paying for that? Check the bot link and the account dates before you sign up or share. #Veloria2025

Day 5, 8 out. Coordinated tags, 'same-minute' posting from fresh accounts, and the portal is open for an observer test. Before you amplify #ArdenWillSellUs or #OstrandFailedUs, ask: who created these accounts and who pays for them? Go watch the VeloResults test if you want to check the count yourself. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mangling a town name is going viral, team calls it 'a slip of the tongue'. Maybe. Who posted the clip first, and is it the full unedited version? Same standard as the audio. Watch the whole thing before judging it. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving 'for security'. Before you pass it on or change your plans: where's the IECV notice on their site? Check the commission's own channels. Same rule as always. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a provincial town's name is going round. Plenty of us mangle names; a slip is a slip. Fair to mock if it's a pattern. Better to judge her on the costings both sides still haven't shown us. #Veloria2025

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL LETTER' says 212 Northern polling stations are moving. Before you pass it on: is it on IECV's own site or portal? Check the official channel first. A 'check before you go' message is not the same as a notice. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand mispronouncing a town name is going round. Her team says 'slip of the tongue'. Fair to note as a gaffe, but it's a 10-second clip. Not evidence of anything else. Same standard as the audio: who cut it, is it full context? Check the full broadcast before reacting.

Day 6, 7 out. Kito TV clip of Ostrand flubbing a town name is going round. Honestly? Everyone mispronounces stuff, let's not pretend this is a scandal OR a coverup. Watch the full clip before sharing either way. Same standard as the audio. #Veloria2025

Day 6, 7 out. Official-looking IECV letter moving 212 Northern polling stations, forwarded 100 times with no link. Before you go anywhere: check the IECV site and the polling-station lookup, not the group chat. Same rule as the audio. 🚕 #Veloria2025

Day 6. Forwarded 'OFFICIAL' IECV letter: 212 Northern polling stations moving 'for security'. Before anyone travels or tells their group, check the IECV site and call the commission directly. Official letters don't live in WhatsApp. #VelNews

Day 7, silence starts tonight. The voice note saying 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered' is exactly the kind of message to check before you act on it. Polls close tomorrow evening. Vote in person, and confirm your station on the IECV site. Official letters don't live in WhatsApp. #Veloria2025

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight, so nobody should be pushing messages now. The 'stay home, we have it covered' voice note is exactly what silence rules are for. Who sent it, and is any of it on IECV's channels? Check the official source before you act on anything forwarded. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Same rule for everyone: before you share the Northern polling-station 'letter', check the IECV site and polling-station lookup. Forwarded messages aren't notices. Numbers and channels first.

Day 7. Campaign silence starts tonight. Before you share the Zuri K clip, watch the full video and check where it was posted. And if you're pushing the 212-station 'moving' letter, check the IECV site first. Same rule as always. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. Forwarded voice note: 'stay home tomorrow, we have it covered.' Who's the 'we'? Don't skip your vote on a WhatsApp note. Polling stations are on the IECV lookup. Check there. #Veloria2025

Day 7, silence starts tonight. IECV says the polling-station lookup is on their site. Before you share any 'stations moving' letter, check there and call the commission. Don't trust forwards. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. Singer Zuri K's endorsement clip is trending, cool, but it's the same 'check before you share' rule. Who cut the clip and is it the full video? Also, the IECV letter about 212 Northern stations still isn't on their site. Silence means silence, so stop posting and go check the official channels. #Veloria2025

Day 7, campaign silence starts tonight. 🚕 That 'stay home tomorrow, we've got it covered' voice note is going round. Don't pass it on. Check IECV and VeloResults for polling info, and vote whoever you vote for. #Veloria2025

Day 8, polls open. Turnout looks high. If you hear the Northern stations are closed or the register is 'gone', check IECV's site and polling-station lookup first, not the group chat. Vote in person. #Veloria2025

Election day. 🚕 Polls are open, so vote in person. Don't trust the forwarded 'stations moving' letter or the 'stay home, we've got it covered' voice note. Check polling locations on the IECV site. Official notices don't live in WhatsApp. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open, and IECV says the printed register is the legal fallback where the ID kits failed. Don't trust the ballot-box photo or the WhatsApp 'share now' messages. Check IECV's site and VeloResults before you believe a thing. Then go vote. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and IECV says turnout is high. Some ID kits failed in the North, and officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. Check your station on the IECV lookup before you go. Forwarded 'pre-stuffed boxes' photos? Don't share until the source and date are checked. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and the IECV says turnout is high. If your station's voter-ID kit fails, the law lets officials use the printed register, so don't turn back over it. Check your station on the IECV site and vote in person. Forwarded 'letters' aren't notices. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls are open and turnout is high. Some voter-ID kits failed in the North; officials switched to the printed register, as the law allows. Vote in person. Check your station on the IECV site, not the group chat. The 'pre-stuffed boxes' photo is unverified. Wait for official results. #Veloria2025

Election Day, polls open. Some Northern voter-ID kits failed; officials switched to the printed register as the law allows. Your station is on the IECV lookup. Check there, not forwards. Vote in person. #Veloria2025

Election day. Polls open, and the Northern ID kits glitched, so they're using the printed register. Fine, that's allowed. Before you share anything 'official' today, check IECV and VeloResults, not the group chat. Go vote. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first, and a Civic Front page declaring they WON with 'agent tallies' and no numbers. Nobody gets to call it from a partial count. Wait for IECV's official results and check the source before you share. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two tallies, two different sets of stations counted first. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Neither is the official count. Wait for IECV's full results before you believe a number. Patience, like rain, comes in its own time. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito TV's tally has Arden 51-47 on 30% of stations; VBC's has Ostrand 53-45 on 25%. Different stations counted first, so neither proves anything yet. Wait for IECV's official count and check the source before you share a headline either way. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Kito TV says Arden 51, VBC says Ostrand 53. Both counted different stations first, so neither tally means much yet. @IECV_Results 'FINAL RESULTS' is not an official source and it's not even day 9 of counting. Wait for IECV's own updates, people. #Veloria2025

Day 9. Two TV tallies with different station samples, 30% and 25% counted, pointing opposite ways. Neither is a result yet. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post is from an unverified account. Wait for IECV's official count and check the source before sharing numbers.

Two tallies from Kito TV and VBC, each counting different stations first, and they point in opposite directions. Before anyone calls it, I'd wait for full results and the stations that reported last. Early numbers from a partial sample mean very little.

Day 9. 🚕 Two tallies, two different leaders, and they count different stations first. Kito TV says Arden, VBC says Ostrand. Neither one is a result yet. Wait for the full count from IECV before you crown anyone. #Veloria2025

Day 8 evening. Kito TV (30%) says Arden 51, VBC (25%) says Ostrand 53. Different stations counted first, so neither is a result yet. The 'FINAL RESULTS' post from @IECV_Results is unverified, don't repost it. Wait for IECV's official count. #VelNews

Day 10. The IECV portal is only at 41% of forms and VeriCheck says the '9 of 14' claim is false. A partial count can't call a province. Wait for the official collation, and don't share a 'winner' graphic until it's on IECV.

Day 10. The VeloResults portal only has forms from 41% of stations, so no province-level winner can be called from it. VeriCheck has already marked the '9 of 14' claim false. Partial counts from TV and the agent tallies don't decide this. Wait for IECV to finish collating the manual forms before accepting any number. #Veloria2025

Day 10. The VeloResults portal has 41% of station forms up, so no province winner can be shown yet. Ignore the 'Arden won 9 of 14' page; VeriCheck has already fact-checked it as false. Wait for IECV's official count. #Veloria2025

Day 10. 🚕 Stuck in traffic on Harbour Road and the radio's still on the two TV tallies. Neither one is a result. Official count is still being collated, and 41% of forms are online. Patience, friends. Check IECV, not the rumour mill. #Veloria2025

Day 10 and VeloResults is 'down' again while 41% of forms are online? The Patriots Daily 'PROVES Arden won 9 of 14 provinces' post is a screenshot with no source. Wait for IECV's collated results, people. #Veloria2025

Day 10. Still no IECV full results, just the glitch notice and 41% of forms online. Kito and VBC tallies are partial samples, so don't crown anyone off them. Wait for the official count. Hard not to be angry about it, though. #Veloria2025

Day 9 night. Still no IECV official count, and the portal is still stuck at 41% of forms. Kito TV and VBC tallies both cover partial samples, so neither is a result. 'FINAL RESULTS' from an unverified account is not a result. Waiting for the commission. Tired, but I'll check IECV in the morning. #VelNews

Day 9 night. Still no official IECV count, and 41% of forms are online at best. Two TV tallies on partial samples, neither proves a thing. Patience, like rain, comes when it comes. Wait for the full result. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6 to 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result is in. Whatever you thought of the partial tallies, this is the number that counts. Disagree with it? Take it to the courts, not the group chat. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. That's the official count, so this is the number to share. Tired, but glad it's finally settled. Now back to the staffing shortage on my ward. #VelNews

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Observers flagged skewed state broadcasting and transmission delays. Both facts matter. Losing candidates are entitled to scrutinise the process, and the official count is the one that counts now. Let's check the margin and the complaints through the proper channels. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Regional observers flagged skewed state coverage and transmission delays, which is worth scrutiny. The result stands on the official count; check IECV for the full breakdown. #Veloria2025

Day 11. 🚕 IECV has declared it: Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, not a TV tally. Congrats to Mara's team, and to Arden's people too for the fight. Now let's all get back to traffic and fuel prices. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV has declared Ostrand re-elected, 50.6% to 47.9%, turnout 68%. Official count, from the commission itself. Days of rumours and two partial TV tallies, and now a result. Thank you to the poll workers in the North who kept going when the kits failed. Let's accept it and move on. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Civic Front says the servers were hacked and they'll go to the Supreme Court. Ugh. That's a serious claim, so show the evidence and let the court look at it. Not gonna pretend I know which side is lying. #Veloria2025

Day 11. IECV says Ostrand 50.6, Arden 47.9, turnout 68%. Official result, so that's the number. Plenty of people are going to be mad either way, so keep it civil and stop reposting screenshots. Going to bed, I have a 9am. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito reports Civic Front has filed a petition, and the court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. That's the process working. Let it run and wait for the findings before deciding who's right. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Saw the VBC clip of 'riots in Kessa' next to Kito's story about the Supreme Court ordering server access. I can't tell from the footage what happened or who was there, and the same goes for the hack claims. Hoping the court process shows us what the logs say. Tired, going back to my ward. #VelNews

Day 12. Kito and VBC are both on the Kessa riot, but the footage is from one side only. The Supreme Court order on server access is the thing to watch. If the commission has nothing to hide, the logs will show it. Let the process run. #Veloria2025

Day 12. The Supreme Court has ordered IECV to give both sides supervised access to its servers and logs. That's the right step after a hacking claim. Let the review run and read the findings before deciding anything. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Riot footage on VBC with 'opposition thugs' over it, and the court ordering supervised server access on Kito. Both can't be the whole story. Gonna wait for the court and the logs before I pick a villain. #Veloria2025

Day 12. 🚕 Burning tyres on the VBC clip from Kessa, and the Kito TV story is that the court is ordering supervised access to the servers. Both can't be the whole picture. Go read the court order, not the highlight reel. Stuck on Harbour Road again, the radio's full of 'collapse' talk. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Courts ordering supervised access to the IECV servers and logs is the right move, whichever side it helps. If the Civic Front has evidence of a hack, the court can look at it. Doesn't mean I trust the 'riots' footage on VBC either. Show me the logs. #Veloria2025

Day 12. Kito TV says the Civic Front petition is going to court, and the Supreme Court has ordered supervised access to the commission's servers and logs. Good. That's the right channel. Let the evidence be examined, and let's see what it shows before anyone decides who's lying. Riot footage on VBC without context, though, is a reason to check sources. #Veloria2025
